title: Enhancing Stock Market Information Retrieval with Retrieval-Augmented Generation
abstract: arXiv:2611.03747v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Natural Language Processing (NLP) has been widely applied in financial domains, enabling automated analysis and retrieval of stock market information. However, traditional NLP-based systems often struggle with maintaining contextual accuracy and generating relevant responses in dynamic financial environments. To address these challenges, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) models have emerged as a powerful solution, combining retrieval-based methods with generative capabilities to enhance response quality. In this study, we present a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) system designed to generate responses related to stock market information. The system integrates retrieval-based and generative approaches to enhance the accuracy and relevance of financial text generation. translated_title: 基于检索增强生成的股票市场信息检索优化
translated_abstract: 自然语言处理（NLP）已广泛应用于金融领域，实现了股票市场信息的自动化分析与检索。然而，传统的基于NLP的系统在动态金融环境中往往难以保持上下文准确性并生成相关响应。为应对这些挑战，检索增强生成（RAG）模型作为一种强大的解决方案应运而生，它将基于检索的方法与生成能力相结合，以提升响应质量。在本研究中，我们提出了一种旨在生成与股票市场信息相关响应的检索增强生成（RAG）系统。该系统整合了基于检索的方法和生成式方法，以提高金融文本生成的准确性和相关性。为评估其有效性，我们采用ROUGE指标（具体包括ROUGE-1、ROUGE-2和ROUGE-L）来衡量词汇和结构层面的相似性……
tldr: 本文提出一种整合检索与生成方法的RAG系统，用于生成准确且相关的股票市场信息响应，并通过ROUGE指标验证了其有效性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) system that integrates retrieval-based and generative approaches to produce accurate and relevant stock market information responses, with effectiveness evaluated using ROUGE metrics.
